messages:
maya: quick heads-up — i'm putting a proposal together for model adoption gates + a bump/pinning policy for the catalog. want quick feedback before i lock it. TL;DR: define bench gates, rollout/canary defaults, auto vs manual pin rules, and customer migration windows.

jonah: +1. can you list the gates you have in mind? also need automation hooks for rollouts.

maya: initial thought: 1) latency p95 within 15% of baseline or absolute < 300ms (hosted profile); 2) quality delta vs pinned baseline within +/-1% on core evals; 3) memory/kv usage within hardware limits; 4) safety filter pass rate >= baseline. if all pass -> eligible for canary.

alex: add: reproducible eval suite (seeded), embedding-similarity thresholds for retrieval use cases, and a minimal hallucination check using our eval harness. also must run our long-context regression tests.

priya: for rollouts we need defaults: canary_percent=5, duration=24h, health-checks every 1m. rollback triggers: error_rate increase > 0.5pp OR latency p95 increase > 15% OR token-cost > expected by 20%. automation should support incremental ramping.

liam: customer-facing concerns: Dedicated customers expect pin stability. propose: breaking changes => 90d notice + migration assistance; non-breaking patches => auto-upgrade opt-in by default for hosted, opt-out for dedicated unless they request auto-bump.

jonah: concrete manifest example for automation: ```
model_manifest:
  id: my-model-v2
  compatibility: minor  # minor|major
  pin: false            # if true, do not auto-bump
  rollout:
    canary: 5
    duration_hours: 24
    health_checks:
      - error_rate
      - p95_latency
```

alex: for eval thresholds we should store per-model baselines. propose a small meta-entry: "eval_profile: retrieval_v1" and keep historical scores so we can detect quality regressions vs last pinned.

priya: automation-wise, we need a runbook task that triggers rollback when thresholds hit and emits a config change: `redwood rollback --model my-model-v2 --reason "latency regression"`. also want automatic snapshots of KV cache sizes pre-rollout.

liam: exceptions: security fixes can be fast-tracked but still notify customers within 48h. any forced deprecations must include a migration path (shim or alias) where feasible.

maya: sounds good. i'm leaning toward policy: - "auto-eligible" for compatible minor revisions that pass gates; - "manual pin" for major compatibility changes; - 90-day notification for breaking changes; - 30-day opt-in window for early adopters before global rollout. will draft final doc.

jonah: i'll own the rollout automation and the manifest parser.

alex: i'll own eval profiles and the baseline snapshots.

priya: i'll own the SLO checks + rollback automation hooks.

liam: i'll draft the customer communications and the migration playbook (templates + FAQs).

maya: thanks all. i'll put a PR in product-infra with the policy + gating checklist and a sample manifest. if no objections by EOD Fri (1829065600) i'll merge and start a phased rollout. :calendar:

deploy-bot: scheduled reminder set for 1829065600 to review model adoption policy PR.
